```cpp
/**
 * Definition for singly-linked list.
 * struct ListNode {
 *     int val;
 *     ListNode *next;
 *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(NULL) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    bool hasCycle(ListNode *head) {
        ListNode* slow = head;
        ListNode* fast = head;
        bool met = false;

        while (fast != nullptr && fast -> next != nullptr){
            slow = slow -> next;
            fast = fast -> next -> next;

            if(slow == fast){
                return true;
            }
        } 

        return false;

    }
};
```
